unit.name: Quantum Mechanics and Density Functional Theory

subtopics.t: Quantum basics: Schrodinger equation, particle in a box

Introduction to software package Quantum Espresso/Siesta Atomic scale methods
solving MD problems using LAMMPS Mesoscopic methods
introduction to software packages Open Calphad /Open Phase/Thermocalc/MicroSIM Continuum simulation methods

introduction to programming methods and algorithms used in the course
